coverage_inventory.interpretation: VIIRS detections and source_file/platform/pass metadata do not establish that undetected cells were observable and clear. No absence-of-fire label can be assigned from a missing detection alone.

pipeline_semantics.incident_association: scripts/resq3/check_inputs.py:event_detections filters type==0 and assigns space-time connected components; incident component is selected from first-date point nearest candidate ignition.
pipeline_semantics.origin: scripts/resq5/setup_incidents.py: first associated detection minus 12 h, floored to hour; protocol origin, not observed ignition.
pipeline_semantics.timestamp: acq_date + acq_time HHMM; source minute precision; pass median floored to minute; elapsed value saved rounded to 0.01 h.
pipeline_semantics.target: scripts/resq5/analyze.py: cumulative union of confidence n/h event-associated detections; nominal 375 m global-origin keys in EPSG:32644 mapped to 30 m model cell centers.
known_limitations: scan/track fields are retained but current rasterizer uses nominal key blocks, not pixel footprint geometry
non-positive cells are zero in historical labels without observation coverage

limitations_and_missing_inputs: Per-cell clear-sky, cloud, quality/valid-view opportunity masks for FIRMS observations
Incident-linked, sufficiently complete pre-origin fire-free observation record
Time-resolved independent fire perimeter or newly burned-area labels for true spread
Verified MCD64A1 derived artifact and resolved listing-size provenance for E2024-155286
